当您的游戏应用需要提升渲染性能、解决卡顿掉帧问题时，可使用游戏渲染加速服务的超帧、ABR、OpenGTX能力
当需要实现游戏资源包的静默后台下载和高效更新时，可使用游戏资源加速服务
当希望实现游戏冷启动秒级打开时，可接入游戏启动加速服务
本Kit适用于各种游戏类型，从休闲游戏到重度GPU渲染的大型3D游戏均可受益，也适用于使用Unity等游戏引擎开发的应用
为游戏接入超分辨率提升画质并降低原生渲染分辨率 / Integrate super resolution for a game to improve image quality while lowering native render resolution
实现动态分辨率缩放让帧率保持稳定 / Implement dynamic resolution scaling to keep frame rate stable
接入 OpenGL ES 游戏的插帧能力提升高刷屏流畅度 / Add frame interpolation to an OpenGL ES game for smoother high-refresh gameplay
为 Vulkan 游戏启用运动估计和补帧优化渲染性能 / Enable motion estimation and frame generation for a Vulkan game to optimize rendering performance
集成 OpenGTX 根据负载自动调节帧率和功耗 / Integrate OpenGTX to automatically tune frame rate and power usage based on workload
实现游戏快速启动减少首帧等待时间 / Implement fast game startup to reduce time to first frame
后台托管下载大型游戏资源包并支持断点续传 / Host large game asset pack downloads in the background with resume support
前台下载纹理和地图资源切到后台后继续拉取 / Download textures and map assets in the foreground and continue fetching them after moving to background
按设备温度和性能档位自适应调整渲染策略 / Adapt rendering strategy based on device temperature and performance level
管理游戏资源包的下载任务状态和进度回调 / Manage game asset pack download tasks, status, and progress callbacks
降低高负载场景的 GPU 压力并减少掉帧 / Reduce GPU pressure in heavy scenes and minimize frame drops
为大型 3D 游戏接入稳态渲染以平衡画质与功耗 / Add steady-state rendering for a large 3D game to balance visual quality and power consumption
do_not_use_when: 需求是创建或移除企业数字空间、配置深度冻结、控制空间互传文件审批，或做企业账号认证与后台用户数据访问管控；应改用 enterprise-space-kit / The requirement is to create or remove enterprise digital spaces, configure deep freeze, control inter-space file transfer approval, or handle enterprise account authentication and background user-data access control; use enterprise-space-kit instead

需求是排查崩溃与卡死、记录应用事件、做链路跟踪、健康监控，或使用HiLog、HiTraceMeter、hdc等DFX工具；应改用 performance-analysis-kit / The task is crash or freeze troubleshooting, app event logging, trace analysis, health monitoring, or using DFX tools like HiLog, HiTraceMeter, and hdc; use performance-analysis-kit instead

需求是使用云函数、云数据库、云存储或预加载服务，进行端云一体化的Serverless开发；应改用 cloud-foundation-kit / The requirement is Serverless development with cloud functions, cloud database, cloud storage, or preload services for integrated device-cloud apps; use cloud-foundation-kit instead
preconditions: 目标应用为游戏或图形密集型应用，且运行设备属于本Kit支持的设备类型 / The target app is a game or graphics-intensive app, and the runtime device is among the device types supported by this Kit
应用图形栈已采用受支持的图形API（OpenGL ES或Vulkan）并具备可接入的渲染流程 / The app graphics stack already uses a supported graphics API (OpenGL ES or Vulkan) and has a render pipeline that can be integrated

若使用资源包加速，module.json5中已声明网络权限，且相关ExtensionAbility组件类型配置正确 / If resource package acceleration is used, network permission is declared in module.json5 and the related ExtensionAbility component type is configured correctly
若使用秒级启动，应用已获得并开通对应开放能力，且按开发准备完成相关配置 / If instant game startup is used, the app has obtained the required access entitlement and completed the necessary setup
inputs: 图形API与渲染模式信息（OpenGL ES/Vulkan、超帧/ABR/OpenGTX） / Graphics API and rendering mode information (OpenGL ES/Vulkan, frame generation/ABR/OpenGTX)
游戏渲染管线接入点与纹理/Buffer信息 / Game render pipeline integration points and texture/buffer information
资源包描述信息（manifestUrl、资源包URL、任务参数） / Resource package descriptors (manifestUrl, package URL, task parameters)
ExtensionAbility或前台下载流程配置 / ExtensionAbility or foreground download flow configuration
快速启动所需的应用启动流程与内存镜像相关配置 / App startup flow and memory-image-related configuration for fast launch
outputs: 超帧生成帧（内插帧、外插预测帧、增强模式生成帧） / Frame-generation output frames (interpolated frames, extrapolated predicted frames, enhanced-mode generated frames)
经系统送显的加速渲染画面帧 / Accelerated rendered frames submitted for system display
ABR 自适应分辨率调整后的渲染缓冲区与画面结果 / Render buffers and image output after ABR adaptive resolution adjustment
OpenGTX 动态调整后的目标帧率、刷新率与频率策略结果 / OpenGTX-adjusted target frame rate, refresh rate, and frequency-policy results
游戏资源包后台下载任务结果 / Background game resource package download task result
已下载或更新完成的游戏资源包文件 / Downloaded or updated game resource package files
资源包下载进度、状态与完成/失败结果回调数据 / Resource package download progress, status, and completion/failure callback data
前台下载切后台后的接续下载结果 / Continued-download result after switching from foreground download to background
游戏启动加速生成的游戏内存镜像 / Game memory image generated for launch acceleration
基于内存镜像恢复后的秒级启动游戏运行状态 / Seconds-level restored game runtime state from the memory image

postconditions.statement: 已在代码或配置中接入至少一种图形加速能力、资源下载加速能力或游戏启动加速能力 / At least one graphics acceleration, resource download acceleration, or game startup acceleration capability is integrated in code or configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show concrete integration of this kit by adding or modifying code/config for at least one of: frame generation, ABR, OpenGTX, resource package accelerated download, or instant startup?

postconditions.statement: 若实现资源包加速，已补齐网络权限与ExtensionAbility相关声明或下载任务发布逻辑 / If resource package acceleration is implemented, the necessary network permission and ExtensionAbility declarations or download task publishing logic are added
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes target resource package acceleration, do the edits include the required permission/config declarations and/or code to publish or manage download tasks?

postconditions.statement: 若实现渲染加速，改动中明确绑定到受支持的OpenGL ES或Vulkan渲染路径，而非停留在通用占位说明 / If rendering acceleration is implemented, the changes are clearly tied to a supported OpenGL ES or Vulkan render path rather than generic placeholders
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes target rendering acceleration, do they modify a concrete OpenGL ES or Vulkan rendering path with kit-specific integration rather than only adding comments or vague stubs?

postconditions.statement: 若实现秒级启动，已加入相应启动恢复流程或配置，而不是仅修改普通启动文案 / If instant startup is implemented, the corresponding startup restore flow or configuration is added rather than only changing ordinary launch text
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes target instant startup, do the edits add real startup-acceleration flow/configuration related to restore or memory-image launch instead of superficial UI/text changes?
